feeds.title: Lola Akinmade Åkerström Geotraveler's Niche Blog
feeds.description: Nigerian-born Stockholm-based Lola Akinmade is an awarded travel photographer and writer. Exploring culture through food, tradition, and lifestyles.

feeds.title: Hey! Dip Your Toes In
feeds.description: Eulanda & Omo Osagiede are London-based freelance writers and award-winning social influencers who run the popular travel, food, and lifestyle blog HDYTI (Hey! Dip your toes in). The husband and wife blogging team sharing non-formulaic travel tips, recipes, and local lifestyle happenings!

feeds.title: One Girl One World
feeds.description: I'm a California girl who's got an incurable case of the travel bug! One Girl: One World is a travel blog that's taking you around the world and back! My mission is to inspire people from all walks of life to get out there and experience all the world has to offer! I encourage you to talk to strangers, learn new languages, try new foods and dance to a different beat!

feeds.title: Joanna E
feeds.description: Joanna E, an IT professional and award-winning travel blogger, runs a lifestyle platform. She shares travel guides, style tips, and beauty insights, inspiring millennial and professional women to prioritize travel despite their busy lives. With passion, she empowers women of colour to pursue their dreams, whether traditional or not.

feeds.title: An Unstoppable Journey
feeds.description: Traveling the world and running it, too. That is what the travel blog An Unstoppable Journey is all about. Monique, an American expat, and mom of 2 who has lived in The Netherlands for more than 20 years is on a quest to 'run the world', and to date, has run over 40 full and half marathons in 34 countries across six continents.

feeds.title: Outdoorsy Diva
feeds.description: Misadventures of an Outdoorsy Diva is a travel blog sharing adventure, travel, and food. Tampa, FL is home base but my adventures take me around the world.

feeds.title: Pink Skies and Paradise Blog
feeds.description: Pink Skies and Paradise is an amazing travel blog curated by Siobhan Patrina. Follow me on all my travel endeavours and my beautiful journey across the globe.

feeds.title: Oneika the Traveller Blog
feeds.description: This is a travel and lifestyle blog penned by a Jamaican-Canadian who has been to nearly 100 countries. Toronto-born but New York City-based, she is obsessed with experiencing everything this gorgeous planet has to offer. This travel blog is dedicated to inspiring, encouraging, and empowering women and people of color to see the world.

feeds.title: The Sophisticated Life
feeds.description: I am an award winning travel blogger and proud creator and editor of the luxury Travel & Lifestyle Blog- The Sophisticated Life, LLC. I created this website for those living or seeking to live a sophisticated lifestyle filled with the knowledge of travel, culture, food & wine! Here you will find my personal experiences and stories of traveling around the world. You will also find multiple travel planning guides as well city and country guides.

feeds.title: Foreign Fresh & Fierce
feeds.description: Foreign Fresh & Fierce is a Dallas Fashion, Beauty & Travel Blog in which you will find all the latest trends, styling tips, beauty tips, travel reviews and much more.

feeds.title: Will Drink For Travel Blog
feeds.description: Will Drink For Travel features spirits from around the world, in addition to other great travel tips and information. This blog combines the love of traveling and seeing new places with the love of unique and native spirits.

feeds.title: Spirited Pursuit Blog
feeds.description: A travel blog and visual daydream for those with an unwavering bout of wanderlust sharing dynamic travel stories and captivating photography from a community of world travelers. Sharing beautiful inspiration and practical, helpful information to travel lovers from a fresh and original perspective. Dedicated to those in spirited pursuit of travel, adventure, and new cultural experiences.

feeds.title: Wanderlust calls wanderlust calls to my heart and soul
feeds.description: My name is Debbie and I am a travel blogger. Wanderlust is a strong desire or impulse to wander and explore the world. Find fourteen travel tips to help you do 'bougie travel' on a budget!

feeds.title: Farsighted Fly Girl
feeds.description: A travel blog with musings on travel, fashion and culture. Farsighted Fly Girl features travel narratives, food and restaurants reviews, music and fashion profiles and any aspect of culture that enriches the travel experience.

feeds.title: Our Black Style
feeds.description: Our Black Style is a travel guide designed to give domestic and international travel tips, while sharing images from around the world.

feeds.title: The Blog Abroad
feeds.description: I'm here to inspire others through my journey of being a solo female traveler, pushing the envelope of what's possible, and creating the life of my dreams through a relentless pursuit and downright hustle. Less about travel tricks and tips, this blog is more about what life is like traveling from a personal perspective.

feeds.title: Chubby Diaries
feeds.description: ChubbyDiaries.com is an online community for plus size travelers who are passionate about seeing the world, experiencing new foods, and learning clever hacks along the way. We are authentically REDEFINING what it LOOKS like to travel!

feeds.title: Minority Nomad Blog
feeds.description: I'm Erick! Photographer, Philanthropist, and World Traveler. On a quest to become the first African American to visit every country in the world. 92 Countries DONE!!! Follow my journey and all of the amazing places I've seen and people I've met here.

feeds.title: Black Traveler
feeds.description: Travel writing that reexamines theology, sexuality, and alternative ideas on urban and rural sustainable living.

feeds.title: Moyo Afrika
feeds.description: Moyo Afrika is an online platform created to showcase, empower and connect Africa to the World, Africans in Diaspora, our culture, lifestyle, entertainment and everything that keeps the heart of Africa beating.

feeds.title: The Ugandan Tourist Blog
feeds.description: The Uganda Safari News brings you news and information on Uganda focusing on the gems that make Uganda's Tourism a must visit.

feeds.title: Black Travel Journey
feeds.description: Black Travel journey is a blog dedicated to African American millennials bitten by the travel bug looking to network with other black travelers.
